subject: planner: PropagateConstant can remove useless push down conditions (#63061)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for expression/planner changes. This commit adds a join-aware validity predicate to constant propagation so it can drop newly-derived predicates that would not actually push down to a single join leaf (avoiding redundant “other conditions” and extra projections). The filter only gates newly generated expressions (it does not remove original predicates), and existing NULL-sensitivity safeguards in constant propagation/outer-join handling remain in place, so SQL semantics/correctness should be unchanged. No Blocker/High issues found.
